caption: The drawing depicts an outdoor scene set on a brown, barren landscape with rolling hills. In the foreground and extending into the background is a single-file line of women, all dressed in long, modest dresses in shades of grey, blue, or brown, each with a white apron and a hood or head covering. The women are holding long sticks or rods and appear to be standing along a measured line marked on the ground, which is being held taut by a man at the front right of the line. The man is dressed in blue pants, a grey shirt or coat, and a black hat, and he is facing the women while managing the measuring line. The background features a sky with light blue tones and large, fluffy white clouds, with the horizon tinged with soft yellows and oranges suggesting either sunrise or sunset. There are no trees, animals, or other objects present in the drawing.
title: Planting Corn
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
